lead_headline: Sultan Turkish Bakery opens wholesale operation in Aurora as Post Oak Barbecue eyes October launch near DU

restaurant.blurb: 2 new leads today: Sultan Turkish Bakery debuts wholesale bakery operation at Birchtree Shopping Center in Aurora, while Post Oak Barbecue targets October opening near DU campus — both joining ongoing Dairy Queen closure confirmations in Westminster and Littleton.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications for the sixteenth consecutive day as Colorado's liquor license blackout extends deeper into May with no state explanation. The system freeze since April 30's 2,144-application renewal surge continues without movement — no new filings, status changes, or backend activity across all license types. May's first half closes completely dark as officials maintain radio silence on recovery timelines or systemic diagnosis. The 7-day window holds at absolute zero for the fourth straight week with no departmental communication.
